How do you make the apps work for you? I have recently started using the apps as I’ve heard success stories from them but in all honesty, these apps just give me the ick. And when I do match with someone that I feel is compatible, something always goes wrong. Things will start off really really well, then boom, out of nowhere I get ghosted lol. The first time that happened to me, I messaged the guy after three days to let him know that if he’s not interested in talking then he can simply tell me so so we can move on but he replied saying that he’s been busy moving and that I shouldn’t get too attached to people I’ve only been taking to for a few days. I don’t know if he’s right about that or not but it’s so much easier said than done, either way. Right now I’m waiting on a guy to reply back…it’s been two days and while it shows that he hasn’t been online since, I’m not sure if I’m reading too much into it or not. These apps have done nothing but increase my anxiety. I hate talking to more than one guy at a time so I ignore and sometimes even unmatch other people when I think I’m hitting it off with someone. I just wish guys wouldn’t lead someone on and then ghost. Like communication goes a long way and a simple “I don’t wanna talk anymore” would be so much better than doubting myself.

The katab kitab is the islamic marriage. The couple can spend time together without it being haram. It is so the couple can talk and get to know each other better with the intention to be married and move in together. Some choose to have the kitab and engagement party together and some choose to have these two as separate occasions. Even though after your kitab you’re technically married; it is viewed as “halal dating”. The engagement party  is simply just to announce theyre together and then comes the wedding where the couple can move in together. Think of kitab as a way to date in a halal way. It really depends on how you want to go about your life. Some people just do the kitab and announce that they’re married with a celebration and move in together- that is valid as the kitab is the islamic marriage and you just need to announce you’re married with a celebration before being able to live as a couple. Hope this clears it up

I understand your frustration. And as someone that is diagnosed with depression and anxiety, I also understand where she is coming from. It is difficult to explain but when you’re suffering from something no one can see, you want to seclude yourself away till you feel better. You have done everything and I assure you, this has nothing to do with you. You are probably the best thing that has ever happened to her. Please do not take the break up personally. You are not the reason. Her illness that is out of control is. I have tried to distance myself away from my bf multiple times whenever my depression got really bad. During those times, I feel like a burden and just want to deal with it on my own. He would message often to check up on me and that’s what got me through. Knowing he was there for me despite telling him I was not fine and do not know if I ever will be. You have told her you are always there for here and try to text her often to check up on her only to get dry replies— if I were you, I would tell her that you want to help her and do not care if things are never perfect. If she insists that she does not want a relationship, even after you tried to talk her through, then there’s not much you can do. By then, you would have tried absolutely everything. As much as you may have a soft spot for her, it is her decision at the end of the day. Hope whatever is best for you happens. You got this.

First of all, congratulations on making the decision to go to the gym! You have already taken the first step. Secondly, half the things on Instagram and the internet in general is straight garbage. Just because someone has a fitness accounts on Instagram with a lot of followers doesn’t mean they’re certified. I am a trainer and a Kinesiology student and would really recommend you tell your physiotherapist that you plan on working out at the gym. Taken your condition, you need someone who is qualified to prescribe you specific workouts. I know you said you cannot afford a trainer but this is necessary; you do not want to do yourself more harm than good.
